original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. The proofs of ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen, ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires do not unfold Adjudicator.apply or case on Op; they rewrite with Adjudicator.apply_checkpoint_equation (ArmadaLean/Nitro/OpEquations.lean). The type-doctrine linter reports no layerDiscipline finding for any of these declarations. Statements do not change.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. At integrated 4a9e9981, `lake env lean scripts/type_lint.lean` prints a layerDiscipline finding (linter layerDiscipline, with baseOps) for each of ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen, ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires. The trunk has 35 Nitro layerDiscipline hits in total.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run `lake build ArmadaLean ArmadaLean.Lint.TypeDoctrine` and then `lake env lean scripts/type_lint.lean`; read the JSON lines whose linter field is layerDiscipline and their declaration field. Then run `scripts/check.sh --json`.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. Every Lean command runs through /home/rix/bin/lean-run. No spec statement changes: `git diff integrated -- 'ArmadaLean/Spec*'` is empty. scripts/check.sh --json keeps every _ok field true, lint_ok included, against scripts/gate-baseline.json. A bare `lake clean` is never run.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) ArmadaLean/Nitro/Safety.lean and the other modules that hold the proofs of ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen, ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires
restatement: The proofs backing ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen and ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires must be rewritten so they go through the Adjudicator.apply_checkpoint_equation rewrite (not unfolding Adjudicator.apply or case-splitting on Op), so that the type-doctrine linter no longer reports a layerDiscipline finding for either declaration, while the Spec statements themselves remain byte-for-byte unchanged and the full check.sh gate (including lint_ok and all other _ok fields) continues to pass against the committed baseline.

restatement_clauses.text: After running `lake build ArmadaLean ArmadaLean.Lint.TypeDoctrine` and `lake env lean scripts/type_lint.lean`, no JSON line with linter field layerDiscipline has declaration field ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen or ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires.
The proofs of ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen and ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires rewrite with Adjudicator.apply_checkpoint_equation and do not unfold Adjudicator.apply or case on Op.
`git diff integrated -- 'ArmadaLean/Spec*'` is empty, i.e. no Spec statement changes.
`scripts/check.sh --json` keeps every _ok field true, including lint_ok, against scripts/gate-baseline.json.

goal: Make two specific proofs in the Nitro model use the approved style of rewriting instead of unfolding internals, so a code-quality checker stops flagging them as problems, without changing what the proofs are actually claiming, and without breaking any other project checks.
acceptance_criteria: After building the project and running the type-discipline linter script, nobody should see a reported violation that names the specific declarations ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_can_happen or ArmadaLean.Nitro.checkpoint_requires under the layerDiscipline linter.
Checks that the two named proofs in the Nitro file use the required rewrite lemma and never unfold the apply function or case-split on Op, by scanning the proof source text.
Checking that none of the formal Spec files under ArmadaLean/Spec were changed compared to the integrated branch — the Spec statements must remain untouched.
Running the repository's check script with the --json flag should report that every quality check passed, including the lint check, when compared against the committed baseline file.
